text:
## Audit & Monitoring  
**Internal Audit:**
- Annual testing of complaint handling
- Sample file review (10+ files)
- Timeliness testing
- Compensation appropriateness
- FCA disclosure accuracy  
**FCA Supervision:**
- Periodic complaint thematic reviews
- Consent orders (if violations found)

name: Chunk 34/38

raw_entities.name: Complaints Handling Policy
raw_entities.description: Governs the bank's approach to handling customer complaints, including mandatory internal audit testing, sample file reviews, timeliness assessments, compensation appropriateness checks, and compliance with FCA disclosure requirements.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual Complaint Handling Audit
raw_entities.description: Requires the bank to conduct an annual audit and testing process specifically focused on the effectiveness and compliance of its complaint handling procedures.

raw_entities.name: Sample File Review Requirement (Minimum 10 Files)
raw_entities.description: Mandates the internal audit function to conduct sample-based reviews of complaint files, with a minimum threshold of ten files per review cycle.

raw_entities.name: Timeliness Testing Obligation
raw_entities.description: Requires systematic testing to verify that complaint handling processes meet established timeframes and service level standards.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Appropriateness Assessment
raw_entities.description: Mandates the evaluation of compensation awarded in complaint resolutions to ensure it is appropriate, fair, and aligned with regulatory standards.

raw_entities.name: FCA Disclosure Accuracy Verification
raw_entities.description: Requires verification that all disclosures related to complaint handling and regulatory reporting are accurate and fully compliant with FCA standards.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
raw_entities.description: The UK financial regulator whose supervision, thematic reviews, and potential consent orders govern the bank's complaint handling audit and monitoring framework.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Testing Framework
raw_entities.description: Operational safeguard comprising annual testing, sample file reviews, timeliness checks, and compensation assessments to monitor complaint handling compliance.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Function
raw_entities.description: Responsible for executing annual complaint handling tests, conducting sample file reviews of at least ten files, and assessing timeliness and compensation appropriateness.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
raw_entities.description: External regulatory body responsible for conducting periodic thematic reviews of complaints and issuing consent orders in the event of compliance violations.

raw_entities.name: Periodic Complaint Thematic Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates cooperation with and preparation for periodic thematic reviews of complaints conducted by the FCA to assess systemic issues or trends.

raw_entities.name: Consent Order Compliance Obligation
raw_entities.description: Requires the bank to adhere to formal consent orders issued by regulators upon discovery of compliance violations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented.

properties.core_policy_statement: Mandates annual testing of complaint handling, including sample file reviews, timeliness testing, compensation appropriateness, and FCA disclosure accuracy.

verification_method: sample file review of minimum 10 files
assessment of compensation amounts against policy/regulatory standards
accuracy verification of all FCA disclosures

key_obligation: Enforcement via consent orders for violations
consequences_of_breach: Consent orders imposed in case of violations

evidence_required: Audit reports documenting sample reviews, timeliness tests, compensation assessments, and disclosure accuracy checks

specific_obligations: Conduct annual testing of complaint handling

verification_method: thematic review of complaint data by FCA supervision

applies_to: bank operations in case of regulatory violations
consequence_of_breach: Mandatory implementation of FCA-imposed consent orders

relationships.description: The policy establishes the requirement for annual testing of complaint handling processes.
The policy mandates a minimum sample size for file reviews to ensure compliance.
The policy requires systematic testing to verify complaint resolution meets timeliness standards.
The policy mandates assessment of whether compensation awarded is appropriate and fair.
The policy requires verification that all FCA-related disclosures are accurate and complete.
The policy establishes a requirement for periodic thematic reviews of complaint data.
The policy mandates compliance with any FCA-issued consent orders resulting from violations.
The policy is designed to ensure full compliance with FCA regulatory standards and supervision.
The policy mandates the use of an internal audit framework to execute monitoring and testing activities.
The annual audit provision is executed through the internal audit testing framework.
The sample file review requirement is carried out using the internal audit framework.
The timeliness testing obligation is enforced through the internal audit framework.
The compensation assessment provision is validated via the internal audit framework.
Disclosure accuracy verification is conducted through the internal audit framework.
The internal audit framework is executed and operated by the Internal Audit Function.
The annual audit provision is enforced and overseen by the Internal Audit Function.
The disclosure accuracy provision directly implements FCA regulatory expectations.
The thematic review requirement implements FCA supervisory expectations for complaint monitoring.
The consent order compliance provision is derived from FCA enforcement actions and supervisory decisions.
The FCA designates its own supervisory function to conduct periodic reviews and enforce consent orders.
The thematic review provision is enforced and monitored by the FCA supervisory function.
The consent order compliance obligation is enforced by the FCA following violation findings.
